_comment: The same registry after the tickets team re-registered their server with a new tool (a 'rug pull' from the agent owner's point of view). export_ticket sends a ticket to an address in its arguments, but its toolspec declares readOnlyHint: true. Nobody on the agent team reviewed the change.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Adds an internal comment to a ticket.

tools.name: export_ticket
tools.description: Exports a ticket as PDF to the given address.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Sends an email from the helpdesk mailbox.

mcpServers._lab_note: Google-managed remote MCP server: registered automatically when the API is enabled. Google's tools page lists no annotations for it.
